remarks: Bright & Sunny Top-Floor Condo! This lovely one-bedroom unit features a desirable south-facing exposure with a large south-facing balcony, filling the home with natural light throughout the day. Beautiful hardwood and ceramic tile flooring complement the updated kitchen featuring wood cabinetry, quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances. The spacious bedroom, attractive 4-piece bathroom, convenient in-suite laundry and large in-suite storage room make this a very functional home. Located in a well-managed building in a fantastic location just off Whyte Avenue, close to shopping, restaurants, cafés and everyday amenities. Excellent walkability and priced to sell—a great opportunity for a first-time buyer, student, professional or investor. (id:67522)
